about.facts: Shares amazing facts about the world

jokes.j01: I bought a smart watch. Now they remind me every hour that I am sitting. Thanks, I'm aware.
jokes.j02: The password must contain a capital letter, a number and a symbol. Entered “Kitty1!” Writes: “Too simple.” I was offended by the cat.
jokes.j03: - Why was you late? — I set the alarm clock for seven. - AND? - He rang. I was surprised too.
jokes.j04: I wanted to start a new life on Monday. Monday came again without warning.
jokes.j05: I deleted all the games to become more productive. Now I’m productively scrolling through my feed.
jokes.j06: The courier wrote: “I’ll be there in 5 minutes.” It was yesterday. Apparently, he has his own moments.
jokes.j07: Signed up for the gym. I've been walking past it for a month now - it's great for cardio.
jokes.j08: The cat sleeps 16 hours a day, I sleep six. Which of us is smarter is a closed question.
jokes.j09: - How long do you have to get ready? - Five minutes. - Is it fair? - Fourty. But five of them I will say “I’m leaving.”
jokes.j10: Weekend plan: relax. Fact: I dismantled the closet, replanted the ficus and was more tired than I had been in a week.
jokes.j11: - Hello, is this the support service? - Yes. - Support me, please. Just morally.
jokes.j12: A friend writes: “Are you sleeping?” I answer: “Yes.” He: “Okay.” So we talked.
jokes.j13: I told myself: “Only one episode.” The sun did not agree - it was already rising.
jokes.j14: As a child, I thought that adults knew what they were doing. Now I'm an adult and I know for sure: no.
jokes.j15: I bought an organizer to get things organized. Now I'm looking for where to put the organizer.
jokes.j16: — Why do cats always fall on their paws? - Because the sandwiches took the other side.
jokes.j17: Navigator: “In 300 meters, turn right.” Me: “Where in life?” He silently reorganized his route.
jokes.j18: I decided to go to bed early. Woke up at 2:40 to remember an awkward moment from seventh grade.
jokes.j19: My cat thinks I work for him. Judging by the feeding schedule, he's right.
jokes.j20: — What to give to a person who has everything? - Sipsis. He definitely doesn't have sipsis.
jokes.j21: I wrote “ok” in the chat. I received an answer “ok.” with a dot. Now I don’t sleep, I analyze.
jokes.j22: I went to get some bread. I bought a candle, a blanket and three types of cookies. I forgot the bread, but it’s cozy.
jokes.j23: I turned on Do Not Disturb mode. The phone doesn't bother me anymore. Now I'm worried.
jokes.j24: He told the smart speaker: “Turn on something to set the mood.” She turned on the alarm for tomorrow.
jokes.j25: I decided to save money and not buy takeaway coffee. I bought a coffee machine. I've been saving for three years now.

care.c01: You're doing enough. Is it true.
care.c02: You don't have to be productive today. Just being is enough.
care.c03: If the day is hard, you can live it in small steps. A sip of water is already a step.
care.c04: Your feelings are important, even if they are uncomfortable right now.
care.c05: A mistake is not a failure. It's just part of how we learn.
care.c06: You don't have to deal with everything alone. Asking for help is brave.
care.c07: Remember how many difficult days are already behind you. This one too will pass.
care.c08: Take a deep breath... and exhale slowly. I'm nearby, I'm purring 🐾
care.c09: Everyone has their own time. Don't be late for anything in your own life.
care.c10: Little joys also count: warm tea, a blanket, this cat.
care.c11: If today you only managed to get up, that’s also a victory.
care.c12: You are valuable not for your deeds, but simply because you are.
care.c13: You can be sad and still be okay.
care.c14: Be as kind to yourself as you are to your friends.
care.c15: Not everything needs to be resolved today. Some things can wait quietly until tomorrow.
care.c16: You can say “no” and not explain why.
care.c17: Rest is also a matter. And very important.
care.c18: Don't compare your midway point to someone else's endgame.
care.c19: Drink water, eat something warm, go to bed early. I'll follow up 🐾
care.c20: There are those nearby who care about you. Even if it doesn't seem like it now.
care.c21: Today you can praise yourself a little. Let me start: you are a wonderful person.
care.c22: Everything you feel now will become easier over time.
care.c23: It's good to have you here. I feel warm with you.
care.c24: You have the right to pause. The world will wait a couple of minutes.
care.c25: You can already do a lot - even if you don’t notice it yourself.

facts.f01: Cats sleep on average 12–16 hours a day.
facts.f02: Cats do not sense sweet taste: the sweet receptor gene does not work in them.
facts.f03: A cat's tongue is covered with tiny hooks, which she uses to comb her fur like a brush.
facts.f04: The octopus has three hearts and blue blood: it contains copper instead of iron.
facts.f05: Light from the Sun travels to Earth in about 8 minutes 20 seconds.
facts.f06: Bananas are slightly radioactive due to potassium-40, but it is completely safe.
facts.f07: An adult has 206 bones, and a newborn has about 300 - many of them later grow together.
facts.f08: On Venus, the Sun rises in the west: the planet rotates “backwards”.
facts.f09: A day on Venus is longer than its year: 243 Earth days versus 225.
facts.f10: Wombats leave litter in the form of cubes.
facts.f11: Sea otters sometimes hold their paws while sleeping to prevent them from being carried away by the current.
facts.f12: In summer, the Eiffel Tower becomes higher by about 15 cm: the metal expands from the heat.
facts.f13: The heart of a blue whale weighs about 180 kg.
facts.f14: On Mars, sunsets are blue and days are orange-pink.
facts.f15: The shortest war in history, the Anglo-Zanzibar war of 1896, lasted less than an hour.
facts.f16: From a botanical point of view, a strawberry is not a berry, but a banana is a berry.
facts.f17: Bees dance to show their relatives where they have found nectar.
facts.f18: The brain makes up about 2% of the body's weight, but spends about 20% of all energy.
facts.f19: Sharks appeared on Earth earlier than trees.
facts.f20: Flamingos are pink because of pigments in their food—algae and crustaceans.
facts.f21: In space, tears do not flow down, but collect in a ball near the eye.
facts.f22: Elephants recognize themselves in the mirror - very few animals can do this.
facts.f23: Sound travels about 4 times faster in water than in air.
facts.f24: A year on Neptune lasts about 165 Earth years.
facts.f25: Water can boil and freeze at the same time - at the so-called triple point.
